================================================================================
Vim fg retains its anonymous keyword child
:cst
================================================================================
hi=fg
---
0:0 - 0:5   program
0:0 - 0:2     "hi"
0:2 - 0:3     "="
0:3 - 0:5     color
0:3 - 0:5       "fg"

================================================================================
Vim bg retains its anonymous keyword child
:cst
================================================================================
hi=bg
---
0:0 - 0:5   program
0:0 - 0:2     "hi"
0:2 - 0:3     "="
0:3 - 0:5     color
0:3 - 0:5       "bg"

================================================================================
Vim foreground remains a complete immediate color token
:cst
================================================================================
hi=foreground
---
0:0  - 0:13   program
0:0  - 0:2      "hi"
0:2  - 0:3      "="
0:3  - 0:13     color
0:3  - 0:13       "foreground"

================================================================================
Vim background remains a complete immediate color token
================================================================================
hi=background
---
(program (color))

================================================================================
A general color name remains valid
================================================================================
hi=Blue
---
(program (color))

================================================================================
A hexadecimal color remains valid
================================================================================
hi=#ff00aa
---
(program (color))

================================================================================
Color-shaped word outside the color state is not a keyword
================================================================================
foreground
---
(program (word))
